auto_context.card: This is an archived live stream uploaded on April 28, 2025, from Polka Ch. 尾丸ポルカ (Omaru Polka), a VTuber belonging to hololive's Gamers branch. The stream is part of the ongoing hololive group Rust series known as holoRUST, in which multiple hololive members play together on a shared Rust server. In this session, Polka describes hanging out with Kanata (天音かなた) at Luna's (姫森ルーナ) base, with the main objective being a "tank extermination quest." The tone is casual and comedic, typical of Polka's laid-back streaming style, and the speech is in Japanese.
